text:
Type: tall wood framed wall mirror
Use: checking an outfit, adding light and depth, hung on a wall or leaning; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: Scandinavian, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: solid wood frame with a stepped molded profile in a clear lacquer, mirror glass
Colors: light honey wood, silver reflection
Shape: narrow tall rectangle with a slim profiled frame and softly rounded edges, simple and light, full-length proportions
Feel: warm, simple, bright, classic
Goes with: light wood furniture, white walls, linen; Scandinavian, farmhouse or traditional rooms
